name: Mads Christensen
bio:
Mads' journey into motorsport began with a childhood fascination for aerodynamics, sparked by building model airplanes. He pursued a degree in mechanical engineering, specializing in fluid dynamics, before landing an internship at a smaller racing team. There, he honed his skills in wind tunnel testing and data analysis, quickly proving his aptitude for optimizing vehicle performance. He's now been with Hansen World RX Team for three years, known for his meticulous approach and ability to translate complex data into practical improvements on the track.

Mads thrives on the challenge of fine-tuning aerodynamic setups to extract every last ounce of performance. He's particularly adept at identifying subtle airflow patterns and translating them into tangible adjustments to the car's bodywork. His flexible nature allows him to adapt quickly to changing priorities and collaborate effectively with the team's engineers and drivers. He hopes to one day lead aerodynamic development for a Formula 1 team.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a slight side part.
physical.description: Mads has a lean build and a focused look about him.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook to jot down observations.
Has a particular fondness for licorice and often shares it with the team.
Adjusts his glasses incessantly when under pressure.
